svg.title: Full pipeline: online loop with one GPT-6 model (system 2, planner and coder roles), VLA (system 1), decision gates and code-based correction, plus offline training
svg.desc: Online loop: a task goes to GPT-6 (system 2) in its planner role, which ends in task success or a human handoff, and sends subtasks to the VLA (system 1). The VLA sends several candidate chunks to an uncertainty gate. If not uncertain, one random candidate is executed. If uncertain, the robot pauses and the observation, uncertain chunk and subtask go to GPT-6 in its coder role and to vision tools; GPT-6 sends an object name to the vision tools and control code to the code runner, which plans a collision-free timed motion, split into VLA-format chunks. Fixable code errors return to GPT-6 up to N retries; unfixable errors, N failed tries or a timeout send control to the planner. All code attempts are saved. After execution a failure detection gate uses the VLA progress check to continue, replan or move to the next subtask, and logs data. Offline: training data is sorted by outcome into residual training, self-check training and skill library updates, then offline checks and a supervised real-robot trial before the new VLA, gate and skills are adopted.
svg.text: unfixable error, N tries or timeout: replan
End: ask a human for help
Runs control code: plans a collision-free,
timed arm motion, e.g. hover above object

g.text: skills: dry run on saved scenes
Purple: GPT-6 (system 2) · Teal: VLA (system 1) · Amber: decision gates
Pills: start / end · Dotted: save data · A, B: updates sent from offline training
Code-based correction = Code as Policies · both GPT-6 boxes are one model
